verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Replicate has docs, including get-started guides for Node.js and Colab, and claims models run with one line of code. Nothing shows an interactive API reference or in-browser runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The axis applies to an API platform, but the capability is unevidenced, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
